propositions: Define a language-agnostic Analyzer protocol with AnalyzerResult containing optional fields (loc, complexity, duplication).
resolve_analyzer(lang) must return None when no analyzer is configured and a fallback helper must return Unavailable(reason, accruing_since) without scanning paths or fabricating data.
The Unavailable sentinel must reuse the existing two-argument shape from rebar.metrics.registry, not invent a single-argument variant.
ANALYZERS map and resolution logic must not pollute or collide with existing metrics/registry.py module-level REGISTRY.
New per-language analyzer adapters must live in src/rebar/metrics/analyzers/ package, not in adapters/ which is reserved for harvest/backfill scripts.
Implementation must use pure stdlib only and register nothing into REGISTRY as a side effect (opt-in wiring deferred to ticket 0734).
